classification.small_bridge: Underlying subject knowledge is already well covered. One or two named AQA elements, terminology links, or a short alignment/application explanation remain.
classification.medium_bridge: Several named elements or a specialist model remain. Requires a targeted source/synthesis pass, but not whole-topic generation.
classification.source_gap: No rights-clear subject-knowledge route remains after targeted research. None currently identified in the compulsory course.
